snippet.title: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine | Release Date
snippet.description:
Team up with a friend to reach a lost submarine and prevent the outbreak of war. Work together on two devices to solve increasingly challenging puzzles, where each of you has your own unique role to play.

How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine comes to PC and consoles on June, 24th.
Nintendo Switch | Xbox One | Xbox Series X|S | PlayStation 4 | PlayStation 5
